# SkeletonPreset

Ready-made skeletons with the same geometry as the real components, so the swap from loading to loaded never moves anything.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.SkeletonPreset` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.SkeletonPreset />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.SkeletonPreset"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A ready-made skeleton with the same geometry as the component it stands in for, so nothing jumps on arrival.

## Props (SkeletonPresetProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `'project-card' \| 'feature-card' \| 'stat' \| 'ai-answer' \| 'chat' \| 'list' \| 'timeline' \| 'table' \| '…` | Which real component to mirror. @default "list" |
| `count` | `number` | How many to draw (table counts its header row). Defaults per kind. |
| `featured` | `boolean` | project-card: the first one spans two columns, like the real bento. @default false |
| `columns` | `number` | table: number of columns. @default 4 |
| `animation` | `'wave' \| 'pulse' \| 'none'` |  |
| `onInk` | `boolean` |  |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
